title: Implicit function theorem: local C¹ graph chart of the regular part of a level set of a C¹ function on ℝ^{n+1}
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} open, F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 F), and y₀ ∈ W with DF(y₀) ≠ 0. Then there exist an open set D ⊆ ℝⁿ, a map Λ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+1}, a point c ∈ ℝⁿ, a real ρ and an open set N ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} such that: Λ is C¹ on D and injective on D; for every z ∈ D, Λ(z) ∈ W, F(Λ(z)) = F(y₀), DΛ(z) (= fderiv ℝ Λ z) is injective and DΛ(z)(ℝⁿ) = ker DF(Λ(z)); the closed ball B̄_ρ(c) is contained in D; y₀ ∈ N; and every y ∈ N with F(y) = F(y₀) is of the form y = Λ(z) with z in the open ball B_ρ(c).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (y₀ : Euclid (n + 1)), IsOpen W → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → y₀ ∈ W → fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ (D : Set (Euclid n)) (Λ : Euclid n → Euclid (n + 1)) (c : Euclid n) (ρ : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid (n + 1))), IsOpen D ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Λ D ∧ InjOn Λ D ∧ (∀ z ∈ D, Λ z ∈ W ∧ F (Λ z) = F y₀ ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ Λ z) ∧ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Λ z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ F (Λ z) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) ∧ closedBall c ρ ⊆ D ∧ IsOpen N ∧ y₀ ∈ N ∧ N ∩ F ⁻¹' {F y₀} ⊆ Λ '' ball c ρ
